requirement.original: 彻底错误，为什么高铁会新建一个segment而不是修改原来的transport！这是系统性失误
requirement.clarified: Timeline agent incorrectly adds inter-city transportation (location_change from transportation.json) to travel_segments array. travel_segments should ONLY contain intra-city transport (taxi, metro, walk, bus). Inter-city transport (train, flight) should ONLY appear in timeline object, NOT in travel_segments.
requirement.what: Fix timeline.md agent specification to explicitly exclude inter-city transport from travel_segments array
requirement.why: Data duplication and architectural confusion - inter-city transport appears in both timeline and travel_segments, violating separation of concerns

included: Add explicit rule: travel_segments excludes location_change transport
Add validation: travel_segments must NOT contain train/flight types

success_criteria: timeline.md explicitly states: travel_segments ONLY for intra-city transport
timeline.md excludes location_change transport from travel_segments
travel_segments schema allows ONLY: walk, taxi, metro, bus, ferry (NO train, flight)
Future timeline agent runs will NOT add inter-city transport to travel_segments
constraints: Must not break existing timeline generation
Must preserve backward compatibility with existing data
Must align with transportation.json location_change field

root_cause_analysis.symptom: High-speed train D5121 appears in both timeline object AND travel_segments array for Day 3
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: timeline.md lacks explicit rule excluding inter-city transport (location_change) from travel_segments array. Agent instructions say 'For every gap between consecutive activities that involves travel' without distinguishing intra-city from inter-city
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: e2007ff - fix: 6 HTML generator issues + timeline agent travel_segments schema
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Commit e2007ff added native travel_segments generation to timeline.md but did not specify intra-city vs inter-city distinction. Instructions say 'for every gap' which incorrectly includes inter-city travel
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Creates data duplication (same transport in 2 places) and violates architectural separation (travel_segments purpose is UI rendering of short intra-city hops, not major inter-city journeys)

context.codebase_state: Working on travel plan review for Day 3 (Bazhong → Chengdu)

architectural_design.timeline_object: Contains ALL activities including inter-city and intra-city transport
architectural_design.travel_segments_array: Contains ONLY intra-city transport for UI rendering (taxi, metro, walk, bus, ferry)
architectural_design.transportation_json_location_change: Defines inter-city transport (train D5121), should appear in timeline but NOT travel_segments

file_contents.timeline.md_travel_segments_section: Says 'For every gap between consecutive activities that involves travel' - TOO BROAD, includes inter-city
file_contents.transportation.json_structure: Uses location_change field for inter-city, intra_city_routes for city transport

development_approach.strategy: Add explicit architectural rule to timeline.md distinguishing intra-city vs inter-city transport for travel_segments generation
files_to_modify: .claude/agents/timeline.md - Add CRITICAL rule before travel_segments generation
development_approach.validation_approach: QA will verify timeline.md text contains explicit exclusion rule
